speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is actually connected to the AI bubble.

speaker: Unknown
en: Made me really happy.

speaker: Unknown
en: This whole thing has been at times quite grueling and quite negative and quite brutal.

speaker: Unknown
en: But the love I've found and the joy I've found from community and the people around... Because even in the small groups of haters, even like Gary Marcus and so the people I talked to, Edward Ngueso Jr., Molly White, Brian Merchant, there are so many people who have been loving and caring.
zh: 但我在社区和周围人中找到的爱和快乐……因为即使在一小群仇恨者中，即使像 Gary Marcus 和所以我交谈过的人，爱德华·恩格索·小，Molly White，Brian Merchant，也有很多人一直充满爱心和关怀。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think within especially these very critical moments, when you're very much dialing in on how negative things are, how bad things are, finding the people who...
zh: 我认为特别是在这些非常关键的时刻，当你非常关注事情有多消极、多糟糕时，找到那些……

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe find it repulsive, too.

speaker: Unknown
en: Finding the people... Finding your people.
zh: 找到人……找到你的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who can be...

speaker: Unknown
en: The people who will talk to you about it.
zh: 那些会和你谈论这件事的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even, like, Troy and Jake, my trainers, who are so excited about this.
zh: 甚至，比如，Troy 和 Jake，我的教练们，他们对此非常兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even talking to them about this shit as normal people.
zh: 甚至像普通人一样跟他们谈论这些狗屎。

en: Knowing that there are people there going through their own struggles, but also...
zh: 知道那里有人正在经历他们自己的挣扎，但也……

speaker: Unknown
en: to just give you the perspective and also remind you that you are human too and focus i know this is kind of a all over the place point but it's just it's really easy to get hard locked on everything in life and to kind of get away from why you do things and focus too much on the work when the most important thing at times is just to know there are other people feeling the way you do and when i hear from my listeners my readers a lot the most common thing i feel is they feel like they have a voice and they feel like someone is there for you
zh: 只是给你视角，并提醒你你也是人，并且专注……我知道这是一个有点散乱的点，但这只是……生活中真的很容易对一切死锁，并且有点偏离你做事情的原因，而在工作上投入太多关注，而有时最重要的事情只是知道有其他人感觉和你一样，当我收到很多我的听众、我的读者的反馈时，我最常感觉到的是他们觉得他们有了声音，他们觉得有人在那里支持你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I don't think it can be understated how much it means when you just reach out to someone you love and tell them you love them.
zh: 我不应当低估这意味着什么，当你只是联系一个你爱的人并告诉他们你爱他们时。

en: Tell them their shit rocks.

en: Well, that's a good closing message.

en: So if you have enjoyed the conversation today with Ed, please do let Ed know that you love it down below.

en: I'll link to your website, but also to your YouTube channel where people can learn more.

speaker: Unknown
en: And I would highly recommend you do because it is truly fascinating.
zh: 我强烈推荐你去看看，因为它真的非常迷人。

en: And I think we need more voices that are demystifying a lot of the figazi and the narrative in this moment in time.
